# Code

## Input & Output
```{r}

# Load required library
library(ggplot2)

# Create a sample dataframe
df <- data.frame(
  category = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"),
  value = c(10, 23, 17, 9, 30)
)

# Print the dataframe
print(df)

# Create a bar plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = category, y = value)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Sample Bar Plot",
    x = "Category",
    y = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

## Only Output
